transparent.root: the trigger is the adopter's own control and the wrapper draws nothing around it, so a box class on the wrapper or above it decides the trigger's box as it decides the wrapper's

slots.bubble: arena-fade z-tooltip whitespace-nowrap px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-control shadow-surface-floating bg-base-content text-base-100 font-mono text-ctl-xs

floating.bubble: a tooltip floats over the page, so the region holding its trigger does not decide its contents
